title: TR3 Top Load Washer
lead: The TR3 is the Speed Queen top load washer at its simplest: four cycles, three water temperatures and three dials. Underneath is the same stainless steel tub, Perfect Wash system and 1 HP motor as the models above it.

features.name: Speed Queen Perfect Wash
features.line: Speed Queen's wash system for the TR line: an agitator in a stainless steel tub, with each cycle's wash action set for the fabrics it is meant for.

features.name: Quiet at 43 dB
features.line: Rated at 43 dB during agitation, driven by a variable-speed 1 HP motor. The laundry can run while the house carries on.

features.name: Four cycles, three dials
features.line: Heavy Duty, Normal Eco, Perm Press and Delicate, with hot, warm or cold water and three load sizes. Controls anyone in the house can read at a glance.

features.name: Delayed lid lock
features.line: The lid stays unlocked until the first spin, so whatever turned up late can still go in.

features.name: Three years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the TR3 with a 3-year warranty that covers parts and labor.

specs: Delayed: unlocked until the first spin
